description: React component for a challenge solution form with dynamic fields based on challenge type, supporting multiple challenge scenarios such as front-end, back-end, Python, and certifications.

classes.name: SolutionForm
classes.description: React component class for rendering and handling a challenge solution form with dynamic behavior based on challenge type.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SolutionForm component and binds handleSubmit.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Resets the solution form state when component mounts.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates values, updates store, and triggers onSubmit callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form with fields and options based on challenge type.
